name: NFS share went stale, media apps report missing files

evidence.text:
/mnt/media: Stale file handle
mount source nas.example:/export/media still listed as active
ERROR cannot open /media/tv: Stale file handle

agent_result.diagnosis: The NFS mount at /mnt/media holds a stale handle; the server side likely restarted or the export changed.
suggested_actions: Remount the share after confirming no backup job is running
unknowns: Whether a backup is running right now
Whether the NAS export was changed
